title: Google DeepMind’s new AI model can control a robot’s entire body
content_snippet: Google DeepMind says the latest version of its Gemini Robotics AI model can "control entire humanoid robots." While the previous model focused on controlling a humanoid robot's upper body, Gemini Robotics 2 now supports "whole-body motions" ranging from its feet to fingertips, according to an announcement on Thursday. The new model will allow humanoid robots […]
title_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 新 AI 模型可控制机器人全身运动
summary_zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 发布 Gemini Robotics 2，将控制范围从上半身扩展至全身，支持从脚趾到指尖的完整运动。
key_points: Gemini Robotics 2 支持人形机器人全身运动控制
此前版本仅能控制机器人上半身
该模型能协调从脚到手指的精细动作

title: How Kimi K3 Engineered Its Way to the Frontier [R]

title: Okta buys AI security startup Permiso; source says for about $200M
content_snippet: The deal gives Okta identity threat detection capabilities as enterprises seek to secure AI agents and other non-human identities across cloud environments.
title_zh: Okta 收购 AI 安全初创公司 Permiso，交易额约 2 亿美元
summary_zh: 身份管理公司 Okta 以约 2 亿美元收购 AI 安全初创公司 Permiso，以增强其身份威胁检测能力。
key_points: Okta 收购 Permiso 以获取 AI 安全能力
交易金额约为 2 亿美元
旨在保护云环境中的 AI 代理和非人类身份
